# Protected files pinned to their reviewed git blob content.
# Format: <sha1 of "blob <size>\0<content>"> <path>
# CI recomputes each with `git hash-object` and fails on any mismatch.
#
# A pin is intentional content, not a "do not touch" rule: update a line ONLY in
# the same commit as a reviewed change to that file. Because these five files
# currently hold pending (uncommitted) Phase 3.8 content, a CI run against an
# earlier commit will report a mismatch until this change set is committed
# together with this pin -- that is the intended fail-closed behaviour.

1d77eac06ab244bfb11cbb69980d320c3e0372a5 backend/app/services/features.py
